plan: In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy regardless of what other bidders do. This is because you pay the second-highest bid if you win, not your own bid, so overbidding risks paying more than the item is worth, while underbidding risks losing profitable auctions. With my value at $30, I should bid exactly $30 to maximize expected profit.

In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy regardless of the number of competitors or their strategies. This is because you pay the second-highest bid, not your own bid, so overbidding risks paying more than the item is worth, while underbidding risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior history to suggest otherwise, and since this is a one-shot game, I will bid exactly my value of $35 to maximize expected profit.
